metadata.title: BLDR Epoch//01 | San Francisco, March 9–10, 2027
metadata.description: BLDR is a two-day Solana engineering campus in San Francisco on March 9–10, 2027. Register on Luma.

hero.title: BLDR Epoch//01
hero.tagline: Two days of building, for developers.

about.heading: Built for builders, by builders.
about.intro: Engineers, founders and AI builders, side by side, with the people who make Solana in the room.

callout.body: Less a conference. A temporary engineering campus.

about.imageAlt: A builder smiling and holding up a peace sign in a crowd at night

street.name: The Street
street.description: Between the two. Tents, food, places to sit and talk.

speak.title: Speak at BLDR
speak.body: Propose a keynote, workshop, live coding session or builder session for Epoch//01.

sponsor.title: Sponsor BLDR
sponsor.body: Put your team in front of 1,500–2,000 builders on campus.

newToSolana.question: I’ve never built on Solana. Is this for me?
newToSolana.answer: Yes. You don’t need to have shipped on Solana before. The campus runs workshops, live coding and office hours alongside the main stage.

crypto.question: Do I need to know crypto?
crypto.answer: No. If you write software, you can follow the sessions. The people who make Solana are on campus, so bring your questions.

whenWhere.question: When and where is it?
whenWhere.answer: March 9–10, 2027, in San Francisco. The campus covers three places: The Midway, The Street and Garage 888.

bring.question: What should I bring?
bring.answer: A laptop and a problem you want to solve.

ticket.question: How much is a ticket?
ticket.answer: Registration is on Luma. Ticket details are listed on the registration page.
